top_10.hook: Havells posted an explosive 35% revenue jump, yet the stock dropped 6%! Here is the 'Lloyd Trap' wiping out margins.
top_10.remotion: ComparisonVersus.tsx (Revenue Growth: +34.6% in Bright Green vs Operating Margin Squeeze: Single Digit in Deep Red) + Speedometer gauge dipping from 12% to 7.8% + Rubber Stamp ('MARGIN SQUEEZE')
top_10.happy_investing_angle: Financial Arithmetic: Revenue is vanity, margin is sanity. If a company generates 35% more sales by taking price cuts in loss-making subsidiaries like Lloyd, earnings do not follow. Always check operating margins before celebrating sales growth.
